VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria requires that "all 31 tests pass," which is a verifiable, objective requirement. The only evidence provided is a self-report (SELF class) with no attached CI logs, test output, diffs, or independent artifacts to corroborate the claim. Self-reports are inherently unverifiable and insufficient to confirm that tests actually passed. To satisfy the acceptance criteria, independent evidence such as CI logs (REC), test output artifacts (ATT), or signed verification (SIGN) would be required.
